description: §21.3 / §21.4 — b.scrml re-exports `{ K, Nope }` from c.scrml, which exports only K: E-IMPORT-004 at the re-export. b.scrml and c.scrml are aux siblings (`files` convention), so E-IMPORT-006 does not fire.
rationale: §21.3: "Importing a name that is not exported by the target file SHALL be a compile error (E-IMPORT-004 ...)." A named re-export binds the name from its source exactly as an import does (§21.4), so re-exporting a name the source does not export is the same error. Before S458 it was silent (S458 review F2).
